product: BridgePoint Gaia DR3 local 3D stellar atlas
citation: Gaia Collaboration et al. 2023, A&A 674, A1; geometric distances from Bailer-Jones et al. where supplied
coordinate_frame: Galactic Cartesian, Sun-centred, X toward Galactic Centre, Y toward Galactic North, Z completing right-handed frame

quality.nearbyQuery: parallax > 2 mas; parallax_over_error >= 10; RUWE < 1.4; G <= 17; astrometric_params_solved in (31,95); top 50,000 by parallax
quality.brightQuery: top 10,000 by G magnitude with positive parallax and parallax_over_error >= 5; r_med_geo posterior when available
quality.distance: r_med_geo geometric posterior where available; otherwise 1000/parallax mas for high-S/N stars
quality.propagation: Gaia reference epoch to J2026.0 using Gaia pmra, pmdec and radial_velocity where present
quality.physicalRadius: Gaia radius_gspphot where available; otherwise an explicitly model-derived radius from absolute G and BP-RP temperature proxy
quality.note: This is a high-quality navigable subset, not the full 1.8-billion-source Gaia DR3 catalogue or every Milky Way star.
